verdict.rationale: Appwrite's evidence shows an MCP server letting external LLMs call Appwrite's API, a CLI, and AI-related database/storage features (embeddings, image labeling) for building AI apps — but no built-in AI assistant inside the Appwrite console/product that a user can delegate tasks to. Missing for 10: any documented in-product chat/assistant UI, evidence of task delegation to an embedded agent, or console-level AI copilot feature.
